owner: Codex in James-approved Peninsula Insider page-quality programme

baseline.source: Batch12 exact-public page at 320/390/1440 and independent built-preview visual review. Truthful local photograph and CC source/licence are live, but the dry reserve/sky occupies a giant full-bleed hero and does not convey the bay/wetland journey. Eyebrow reads Sorrento & Portsea although Tootgarook is between Capel Sound and Rye; the regional taxonomy has a broad title that is confusing on this page.

sources.supports: Nearby reserve public paths, boardwalks and facilities.
Actual local photograph and creator; CC BY-SA 4.0 conditions recorded in iteration1.

hypothesis: A framed editorial photograph with text-first introduction, accurate local eyebrow and visible caption/credit makes the truthful image feel proportionate and improves location understanding without substituting an unverified beach photograph.
boundedChange: Add optional heroLayout, heroEyebrow and heroDeck fields to place content; use them only for Tootgarook. The shared template retains its existing full-bleed default for every other place. Frame the current rights-recorded photo, keep its factual caption and linked credit below it, and remove inherited photo text shadow on the new light surface.
metric: At 320/390/1440px title, deck, image, caption and licence are legible without overlap or overflow; source/licence links have 44px mobile targets, image loads, region eyebrow correctly locates Tootgarook, and other place pages preserve the default hero. Full build/CI and public manifest/browser confirm release.
rollback: Remove the optional editorial layout fields and scoped class styles if it degrades mobile reading or image attribution; retain the factual photo and source notes.
independentReview: Independent reviewer identified the oversized dry-field hero and misleading region eyebrow. First revision received a bounded NO-GO for a clipped 320px title and inherited text shadow; both were fixed. Final preview review gave a bounded GO for 320/390/1440px title, deck, caption, source and licence, without overlap or page errors. No full rubric score was assigned; no stronger rights-clear Tootgarook beach/wetland photo was found in the Commons category.

validation.productionBuild: Final exact-source TZ=UTC npm run build:search passed, including content and provenance checks, 1009 generated pages and a Pagefind index of 727 pages.
validation.localBrowser: Final Chrome preview at 320/390/1440px: title fits, text shadow is absent, actual 1920px image loads, accurate eyebrow, caption and source/licence are visible with 44px mobile targets, and no overflow or page errors. The first scripted assertion was case-sensitive against uppercase CSS text and falsely failed; rendered content was correct. Independent final responsive QA gave a bounded GO. Rye retained the default place hero.

hardGatesOpen: Stronger rights-clear destination imagery if obtainable
Direct assistive-technology and field performance checks
Regional taxonomy audit beyond this page

The broad region page itself still uses the name Sorrento & Portsea and includes Rye and Tootgarook; this batch corrects the local hero label only.
No 99/100 score is inferred from the new layout.
nextAction: Release through normal CI and verify the exact public revision, then continue rights-clear imagery and full rubric evidence.
